metadata.description: The Olef plugin for Claude Code: Android emulator and device control with a live viewer.

plugins.name: olef
plugins.description: Run, test and debug Android apps from Claude Code with a live, interactive emulator/device viewer in the Claude Desktop browser pane, Apply Changes, annotations and a status line.

plugins.name: ocloud
plugins.description: Create and orchestrate Olef Cloud agents, workspaces, scheduled tasks, event workflows, conversational threads, and your Olef inbox directly from Claude Code.
